title: Filesystem confinement: what a confined tool can open, observed
note: D-2026-157 (findings R-3, R-4). Each mutation removes one part of the confinement the namespace's init applies with Landlock, the proof that it is in force, the mode that refuses to run without it, or the executor's record of it. The suites observe what the tool could open rather than reading the record.

mutations.name: FC1_nothing_is_restricted
mutations.rationale: the ruleset is built and never applied; every open the policy refuses goes through

mutations.name: FC2_the_restriction_is_not_proven
mutations.rationale: the record says confined without anything having been refused: a false isolation report

mutations.name: FC3_high_assurance_runs_unconfined
mutations.rationale: high assurance downgrades to research when confinement cannot be put in force

mutations.name: FC4_file_rules_carry_directory_rights
mutations.rationale: a file grant carries directory rights the kernel refuses, so a granted file fails the ruleset

mutations.name: FC5_reads_are_not_granted
mutations.rationale: the interpreter cannot read its own library, so every confined tool fails: a sandbox too narrow to run

mutations.name: FC6_write_scope_is_read_only
mutations.rationale: a tool cannot write its declared outputs

mutations.name: FC7_no_namespaces_high_assurance_runs
mutations.rationale: on a host with no namespaces, high assurance runs the tool unconfined

mutations.name: FC8_a_refusal_reads_as_an_exit_status
mutations.find:
if refused is not None:
            # Whatever the status says
mutations.replace:
if False:
            # Whatever the status says
mutations.rationale: a refused run is reported as 'exited with status 126', not as the confinement it was

mutations.name: FC9_the_confinement_is_not_recorded
mutations.rationale: the record says nothing was applied when it was; an operator cannot tell confined from not

mutations.name: FC10_the_tool_gets_no_private_tmp
mutations.rationale: a tool that makes a temporary file fails under confinement

mutations.name: FC11_the_tools_own_packages_are_not_granted
mutations.rationale: a governed tool cannot import its own module

mutations.name: FC12_declared_outputs_are_not_writable
mutations.find: + sorted({str((cwd / rel).parent) for rel in outputs})
mutations.rationale: a tool whose contract names an output and declares no scope cannot produce it

mutations.name: FC13_discard_is_read_only
mutations.find: + ([str(scratch)] if scratch is not None else []) + [_DISCARD],
mutations.replace: + ([str(scratch)] if scratch is not None else []),
mutations.rationale: find_library fails inside the confinement and the run identity comes out UNRESOLVED
